children: Microsoft's new provisional code of conduct for AI training is advocating for a "common-sense view" that AI should remain under human control, Microsoft AI CEO Mustafa Suleyman says on CNBC. "It has to remain a force that is subordinate to our interests, that is aligned to humanity, and has to be something that we can contain," Suleyman says. "It's kind of a surreal moment in the tech industry that we actually have to get up and make that the requirement."(elias.schisgall@wsj.com)
